sections.markdown:
# Accuracy and teaching notes

Hold the overlapping age-only child-restraint chart for issuer/legal verification: it omits size and manufacturer limits and shares endpoints. Do not assert its age bands as a complete current legal rule. Preserve conflicts between tire-sidewall pressure advice on physical49 and door-label/manual advice on physical53. The Newton second-law paragraph, blanket rear-impact airbag claim, tire-type weather absolutes, cargo-barrier roof claim, quantified evasive steering limits and dated or uncited injury/fuel figures require factual review and are not promoted into study facts. Hands-on maneuver performance remains outside this written-test product. [A01] [A02] [A03] [A04] [A05] [A06] [A07] [A08] [A09] [A10] [A11] [A12] [A13] [A14] [A15] [A16]
Memory cue, authored product policy: “Restrain, inspect, prepare; slow and leave space”. The cue retrieves complete cited rules and does not replace their conditions.
Terminology: Active safety helps avoid a crash; passive protection acts during one. Oversteer and understeer distinguish excess turning from insufficient turning as described by the source.
Misconception to correct: Airbags replace belts, or winter tires permit ordinary speeds on ice. The guide says belts remain primary restraints and winter conditions still demand slower travel.
